symptoms: Payment API response time increased from 200ms to 4 seconds.
resolution: Increased database connection pool size and restarted affected application instances.

symptoms: Intermittent payment failures during peak traffic.
resolution: Optimized slow queries and increased database capacity.

symptoms: Users experienced login failures and authentication requests timed out.
resolution: Restarted affected instances and increased memory allocation.

symptoms: Order creation requests returned HTTP 500 errors.
root_cause: A failed deployment introduced an incompatible API dependency.
resolution: Rolled back the deployment and restored the previous dependency version.

symptoms: Payment requests showed increased latency after a new application release.
root_cause: Inefficient application code introduced during deployment.
resolution: Rolled back the release and deployed a corrected version.
